programs.title: Premiere affaire
programs.desc: Nora (Noée Abita) is 26 years old and has recently graduated from law school.She is just assigned her first criminal case, which turns out to be a plunge into the deep end.While in custody, he meets his client, a 19-year-old boy accused of murdering his neighbor.Even though it looks like everyone has already passed judgment on him, she has a lot of doubts.Gradually, through this case, Nora becomes aware of the cruelty of the world around her.He also makes many mistakes that make him start to doubt his life choices.

programs.title: Long Good Thursday
programs.desc: Finland.A widowed farmer becomes a model for the eccentric artist Saimi.A feeling develops between them.This does not please the man's adult sons, who are afraid of losing their property.

programs.title: The Last Vermeer
programs.desc: The Netherlands after World War II.The accountability of Nazi criminals and their accomplices continues.A Jew, Joseph Piller (Claes Bang), who fought in the resistance movement, is to deal with the case of stolen works of art.He accuses the eccentric painter Han van Meegeren (Guy Pearce) of collaboration, who hosted Germans at his hedonistic parties and sold them valuable paintings.The artist faces a death sentence.However, he claims that he traded in fakes he created.His exquisitely crafted fakes are indistinguishable from the originals.Although the evidence points to van Meegeren's guilt, and accepting his version would make the brilliant forger a national hero, Piller begins to believe him.Together with her assistant (Vicky Krieps), she tries to prove his innocence, putting her career and good name on the line.Based on facts, the extraordinary story of a Dutch painter and one of the best art forgers in history.It was based on the biography of Han van Meegeren by Jonathan Lopez.

programs.title: Hollywood On Set 23
programs.desc: The program takes viewers behind the scenes of film production.In each episode, the creators discuss three cinema hits.They show how spectacular effects, impressive sets and acting performances are created.

programs.title: Barry 4
programs.desc: The last installment of the adventures of a paid killer who decided to change his life and tried his hand at acting.As a result of recent events, but primarily because of his criminal past, Barry (Bill Hader) goes to prison.His arrest was led by Gene Cousineau (Henry Winkler), an acting teacher who is now considered a hero by many.Barry's situation has a negative impact on his relationship with Sally (Sarah Goldberg).Gradually, the lonely and betrayed man breaks down and vows revenge.
